drivers: Model directional probability is tilted bearish.
A hawkish repricing of the expected Fed path would increase downside pressure on gold.
DXY and real yields are key confirmation variables.

scenarios.bearish: Hawkish surprise plus rising USD/yields and weak gold follow-through.
scenarios.bullish: Dovish surprise plus falling USD/yields and gold reclaiming structure.
scenarios.mixed: Headline close to expectations or cross-market signals disagree.

invalidation: DXY reverses against the initial interpretation.
Gold reclaims the structure that supported the initial bearish interpretation.
Later communication changes the policy-path interpretation.
whipsaw_risk: High immediately after release; reassess after cross-market confirmation.
